feature.frame_counter.help: Counts rendered frames and reports the count to the log.
feature.frame_counter.name: Frame Counter
feature.imagespace_tint.help: Replaces an imagespace pixel shader with one of our own.
feature.imagespace_tint.name: Imagespace Tint
feature.shader_census.help: Counts the techniques of the engine's thirteen shader classes and reports what the deferred passes have bound. A diagnostic with no effect on the picture: it patches the engine's shader tables while it runs, and it has nothing left to say once it has reported.
feature.shader_census.name: Shader Census
feature.shader_census.names: Ask the engine for technique names
feature.shader_census.names_help: Calls the engine's own GetTechniqueName for every technique found, which is a call into the game rather than a read of it. Turn it off if the census does not survive a run.
menu.restore_confirm: Put every setting back to its default?
menu.title: Community Shaders
performance.frame_note: Frame is wall time between presents; passes are exact.
performance.title: Performance
setting.menu.font_size.help: Size of the text in this overlay.
setting.performance.hud.help: Draws a small display while this overlay is closed.
setting.performance.log_key.help: Writes the current numbers to the plugin log.
setting.performance.measure.help: Times each pass on the CPU and the GPU. Off issues no queries at all.
